title: About Me
content:
I am a data professional with a strong foundation in Economics and Statistics, focused on developing practical expertise in Data Analytics and Data Science.


My approach to data is rooted in statistical thinking, analytical reasoning, and business problem-solving. I believe that data without a narrative is just numbers. I specialize in transforming complex datasets into clear, actionable insights through data analysis, visualization, and storytelling.

I leverage Python, SQL, and machine learning to develop data-driven solutions, solve real-world problems, and continuously expand my technical and analytical expertise.
